newsitem.title: USA: VitalCom says Q3 revenues $2.9 million.
newsitem.headline: VitalCom says Q3 revenues $2.9 million.

text.p: VitalCom Inc said Monday its revenues for the third quarter, ended September 28, fell to about $2.9 million from $5.79 million in the same period of 1995.
The company did not give third quarter earnings figures.
The company again said it expects revenue and operating results for the fourth quarter of 1996 to be less than the comparable period's results in 1995.

VitalCom previously said that it expected to report a net loss for its third quarter on lower revenues and that revenue and operating results for the fourth quarter of 1996 would be lower than the year ago.
VitalCom expects to report earnings October 21.
